description: A shell script for testing handling of invalid or badly named git ref names, including operations like fast-import, branch creation, renaming, deletion, and ref verification, with emphasis on ref name validation and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, runs commands, and checks outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceding command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the output of the preceding command is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output or error streams.
